document.notes: Continuous-use form; the revision in the library is Rev. 8-2023 (manifest: irs-prior, continuous use). Every money box prints TWICE, 'Previously reported' and 'Correct information', and only the boxes being corrected are completed ('Only complete money fields that are being corrected'). A W-2c REPLACES figures of a Form W-2 already in the packet; it adds nothing of its own. Box 9 prints with no caption and no entry. Box c names the tax year corrected, which need not be this return's year.

face_not_boxes.because: Box 9 is printed with no caption and takes no entry (as on Form W-2).

extraction.note: No structured model is bound: no Azure prebuilt-tax model for this form is recorded anywhere in this repo (schema, notes or the 068 model re-verification), and a model name is never guessed. The page is read by the generic reader.
